newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Bus unit buys hotel equity.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Bus unit buys hotel equity.

text.p: Singapore Bus Service (1978) Ltd said on Monday its Waterbank Properties (S) Pte Ltd (WBP) unit paid Singapore $21.2 million for 40 percent of LC Hotels Pte Ltd.
It said in a statement WBP agreed to acquire 20 million ordinary shares of S$1.00 each from ECICS Property Ltd.
The amount would be paid for by WBP in cash from internal resources and bank borrowings.
LC Hotels is an investment holding company incorporated in Singapore and has equity in certain subsidiaries and associated companies involved in hotel ownership and management.
WBP also entered into a joint venture agreement with Lum Chang Holdings Ltd, holder of the remaining 60 percent of LC Hotels.
The agreement was to regulate their relationship as shareholders, the statement said.
SBS added the acquisition of LC Hotels would complement the regionalisation of the group and build up its property division.
